label: Pointwise positive measure
definition: Every singleton has strictly positive measure. The Lean definition applies to any measure; the controls use it only on countable carriers with measurable singletons, where every subset is measurable. This is not the topological support of an atomless measure.
note: Analyst mathematical vocabulary in the shared carrier-probability module, reused by the plenitude controls (#2143) and the modal-carrier controls (#2142); no source attribution or metaphysical application is assumed.
